customer_question: On the registration Review Page, a Submission Requirement item shows a yellow warning due to a Consistency Check 'Invalid' that can't be resolved - is it OK to proceed with submission?
question_variants: What does a yellow warning on Submission Requirements (Consistency Check Invalid) mean on the Review Page?
Can we still submit the registration if a Consistency Check error can't be resolved?
Is a Consistency Check Invalid warning caused by SIG itself something we need to fix?
How long does SIG approval take after Submission when a TCW applies?
actual_issue: While reviewing the Review Page image before final registration confirmation, the customer's registration showed a yellow warning mark on a Submission Requirement item, caused by a Consistency Check 'Invalid' that could not be resolved for the referenced registration content. The customer needed to know whether this was acceptable to proceed with.
plain_english_explanation: Sometimes a registration's automatic 'Consistency Check' flags an issue that isn't actually the customer's fault - it's caused by how SIG itself set up the referenced registration. In such cases, SIG has a Test Case Waiver (TCW) that covers this specific kind of SIG-caused inconsistency, so the warning doesn't block submission. After submitting, an SIG staff member reviews and approves the registration (typically within a few business days), and the customer gets an approval notification by email once it's officially registered.
consultant_answer: The yellow warning mark on the Submission Requirement item, caused by an unresolved Consistency Check 'Invalid' in the referenced registration content, is an SIG-caused issue that falls under a Test Case Waiver (TCW) that SIG allows for this situation. After Submission, an SIG staff member will review and approve the registration; the approval notification will arrive at the customer's registration email within 1-5 business days, at which point the registration becomes official.
decision_logic: A yellow/orange Consistency Check 'Invalid' warning on the Review Page's Submission Requirements does not necessarily block submission - if the inconsistency originates from SIG's own referenced registration data (SIG-caused) and is covered by an SIG-allowed Test Case Waiver (TCW), the customer can proceed with Submission. SIG staff then review and approve the submission (1-5 business days), with approval confirmed via email notification.
final_recommendation: If a Consistency Check 'Invalid' warning appears on the Review Page and is determined to be SIG-caused and covered by an applicable TCW, proceed with Submission; expect SIG approval and email notification within 1-5 business days.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the customer were to delay or avoid Submission due to this warning without recognizing it as an SIG-caused issue covered by TCW, the registration process could be unnecessarily stalled.
